content.title: Who Is Hudson Williams' Girlfriend? Meet Katelyn Rose Larson
content.text: PSA: Heated Rivalry’s Hudson Williams Officially Has A GirlfriendTheir romance pre-dates our Heated Rivalry obsession...@Getty Heated Rivalry: the gay hockey romance that took the world by absolute storm. But while fans knew (quite literally) everything there is to know about Ilya Rosanov and Shane Hollander's relationship, less was known about the love lives of the men who brought them to life - Hudson Williams and Connor Storrie. That is, until now. Hudson Williams made his red carpet debut with longtime partner Katelyn Rose Larson at the Vanity Fair Oscars Party, confirming fan speculation that he does indeed have a girlfriend. It was an unexpected moment, given the actor's emphasis on keeping his love life well under wraps. In December, he shared, 'I think there's never a question for me, when I would dream of becoming in the public eye, that I would want just a level of privacy.' So, who is Katelyn Rose Larson? Here's what we know about Hudson Williams' girlfriend. Who is Katelyn Rose Larson, and what does she do? Katelyn Rose Larson is the girlfriend of Heated Rivalry's Hudson Williams, with the couple making their red carpet debut at Vanity Fair's Oscars afterparty. Although she tends to remain mainly outside of the spotlight, some reports online have said she works as a tattoo artist. It's not known exactly how old she is, but it's thought she's of a similar age to 25-year-old Hudson. Back in February, Hudson appeared to soft launch his girlfriend with a Valentine's Day tribute - shouting out Katelyn as someone who had been 'with me since my 2000 gold Mazda Protégé smoked and squealed and I had no job.' ©getty According to IMDb, Hudson booked his first role in a project that wasn't a short film back in 2024. Given he said Katelyn has been around since before he had a job, it's looking likely that they've been together since at least 2023 (maybe even earlier...) What has Hudson said about his girlfriend? Hudson hasn't said too much about his relationship (which isn't all too surprising given this man loves a little privacy). However, he did touch on fan's reactions to his girlfriend while chatting to Etalk Canada on the Oscars 2026 red carpet. When asked about the response to his Valentine's Day soft launch, the internet heartthrob shared, 'Honestly, I didn't even check the DMs. I'm sure they are probably the exact same. But just to see everyone kind of take her in stride and all the lovely fans supporting her, even thought she's not trying to be out there or be perceived. She's always like, "I don't want to be perceived." They're still just being really warm from what I've been told, and that's really nice.' Like this? Get more Grazia content straight to your browser.
